representativeTask.title: Implement a function spec with pinned Aider through Zeck
representativeTask.description: Run the pinned Aider coding assistant (upstream 5dc9490bb35f9729ef2c95d00a19ccd30c26339c) on a representative corpus task (implement-function). Aider operates with Zeck as its sole AI execution authority: every model call (main completion, weak-model commit messages, chat summarization) becomes a real Zeck execution through the public API; the task result (the implemented function, verified by the corpus check script) and the full Zeck execution trace (lifecycle, route, verification, usage) are exposed.

reproducibility.instructions: From the Zeck repository root: (1) install pinned Aider verbatim into the dedicated venv: python3 -m venv /home/z/my-project/.venv-aider && /home/z/my-project/.venv-aider/bin/pip install -e "git+https://github.com/Aider-AI/aider.git@5dc9490bb35f9729ef2c95d00a19ccd30c26339c#egg=aider-chat" (verify with /home/z/my-project/.venv-aider/bin/aider --version — the output must carry the exact-commit build tag +g5dc9490bb); (2) run the battery: bun run compat/aider/harness/run-battery.ts — it composes the Zeck public API in-process, serves the OpenAI-compatible Zeck adapter on a loopback port, runs pinned Aider over the 5-task corpus under the scrubbed environment and the default-deny egress proxy, and writes deploy/evidence/ppr-018.json with every execution's Zeck trace. The model supply is the sandbox's authorized GLM endpoint (platform-side BYOK material at /etc/.z-ai-config). The website's certified demo run executes the same pinned composition through the PPR-018A harness (the Aider pinned-runtime driver registered at the deployment seam — compat/aider/runtime/aider-pinned-driver.ts).

warnings: PPR-028A Worker A binding (provenance-disclosed): this entry is now BOUND at the deployment seam — the runBinding names the registry id of the Aider pinned-runtime driver (compat/aider/runtime/aider-pinned-driver.ts) registered through the merged PPR-018A harness (createRuntimeRegistry + createDemoRunService at the Demo Mirror run route in apps/dashboard/pages.ts). The binding is the PPR-028 closure work order's Section B authorization of the act PPR-018's original data-only warning reserved for the Lead; final certification remains the Tech Lead's gate (see deploy/evidence/ppr-018.json finalCertification).

The demo runs only when the bound record's DERIVED assessment is AI_EXECUTION_COMPLETE (the harness re-derives the status from the bound record on every run — the entry can never assert one) and the registered driver's pins exactly match the record's pins. The driver verifies the pinned venv's exact revision (the +g5dc9490bb build tag) before every run and refuses honestly when the runtime is absent or mismatched — never a fixture success.
The proof's model supply is the sandbox's authorized GLM endpoint — not an external commercial provider (disclosed in the record's limitations).
